root.name: ユニバーサル・ディスプレイ

relations.text: 25年以上の製造パートナーとして有機EL材料の製造を担う
relations.text_en: PPG has manufactured the materials for over 25 years

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Our manufacturing partner of over 25 years, PPG, continues to manufacture our materials for us

companies.name: サムスンディスプレイ

relations.text: 主要な顧客として売上の10%超を占める
relations.text_en: Samsung Display is a customer providing over 10% of revenue

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2025, we received a majority of our revenue from three customers domiciled in the Asia-Pacific region, BOE, LG Display and SDC, from each of which we had revenue in excess of 10% of our consolidated revenue.

relations.text: 特許ライセンスと材料供給の契約を結ぶ顧客である
relations.text_en: LG Display holds a patent license and a supply agreement with the company

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: The patent license agreement provides LG Display a non-exclusive, royalty bearing portfolio license to make and sell OLED displays under their patent portfolio.

relations.text: 特許のライセンスを受けて有機EL材料も供給している
relations.text_en: BOE holds patent license rights and is supplied OLED materials

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Under these agreements, we have granted BOE non-exclusive license rights under various patents owned or controlled by us to manufacture and sell OLED display products.

relations.text: 2025年に特許ライセンスと材料購入の長期契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: The company signed long-term license and material purchase agreements with Tianma in 2025

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2025, we entered into long-term, multi-year OLED patent license and material purchase agreements with Tianma.

relations.text: 2024年に複数年の新契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: The company entered into new multi-year agreements with Visionox in 2024

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2024, we entered into new long-term, multi-year agreements with Visionox Technology, Inc. (Visionox).

relations.text: 戦略的な関係にあり、有機EL特許のライセンスも続けている
relations.text_en: Konica Minolta is a strategic relationship and a licensee of OLED patents

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We also have strategic relationships with Kaneka, Konica Minolta and Sumitomo, and continue to license our OLED patents and technologies to these customers.

relations.text: 戦略的な関係にあり、有機EL特許のライセンスも続けている
relations.text_en: Kaneka is a strategic relationship and a licensee of OLED patents

source.label: Universal Display 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We also have strategic relationships with Kaneka, Konica Minolta and Sumitomo, and continue to license our OLED patents and technologies to these customers.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
